name: DSR-50
description:
An Eisenmark bullpup bolt-action .50 BMG rifle upscaled from the DSR-1.
Features a hydraulic recoil buffer in the stock and a blast compensator style muzzle device, a combination of sound suppression and a muzzle brake.
Offers decent fast cycling speed for an AMR with very high damage, bullet speed and heavy weight and a small magazine that holds only 3 rounds.

Model Submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
